description: Decode a Base64 string back to UTF-8 text. Returns JSON { decoded }. Input is verified by re-encoding, so anything that is not genuine Base64 is rejected with an error instead of returning plausible garbage; binary payloads that are not valid UTF-8 will also fail. It handles Base64 and nothing else: a string of %20-style percent escapes is not Base64 and will be rejected rather than unescaped. For a JWT use decode_jwt, which splits the three segments and handles their base64url padding for you.

encoded.description: Standard Base64 text. Surrounding whitespace and missing '=' padding are tolerated; the URL-safe alphabet (- and _) is not.

name: decode_base64
